title: Apple launches a new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI and remote-free voice commands
slides: Apple's new TV 4K: what if you never need a remote?
It adds Siri AI for natural voice commands.
But voice control fails in noisy rooms.
If you hate remotes, wait for reviews on accuracy.
Test voice commands in your living room before buying.
thread_text:
1. No Remote Needed?

Apple's new TV 4K adds Siri AI for natural voice commands. But voice control fails in noisy rooms.

2. Siri Takes Over

The remote is optional. Just speak to navigate. But background noise breaks the magic.

3. Noise Kills Voice

In a loud living room, Siri can't hear you. Accuracy drops fast.

4. Wait for Reviews

If you hate remotes, don't buy yet. Real-world accuracy tests are coming.

5. Test Before Buying

Try voice commands in your own living room first. Does it work when kids are yelling?
